Real, though not the weakness the rule names: deep review S6 (open at the cut-off). The path is a fixed name in the shared temporary folder (sv-<tool>.sarif), and whatever file is there is read as the tool's report, so a planted file makes a tool look as if it ran and found nothing, and two runs at once read each other's. Accepted on 27 September with the code unchanged.
